why: Each figure is the same right-angled triangle with a small step in its long slanted side. Figures 2, 3 and 5 are only turned copies of each other. Figures 1 and 4 are mirror images (flipped over): going round them, the step comes on the other side. Turning a shape never makes its mirror image, so the answer is 'Both 1 and 4'.
trick: Start at the right angle and go clockwise: does the short side or the long side come first? The mirror image has the other order.
note: Book key prints 4, but in the figures both 1 and 4 are flipped, so the option 'Both 1 and 4' was added (user's decision).
